question: Who has written the patriotic song ‘Sandese Aate Hai’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Javed Akhtar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Javed Akhtar** is a renowned Indian lyricist and scriptwriter.
 
• He has written numerous popular songs for Bollywood films, including the patriotic song '**Sandese Aate Hai**'.
 
• The song is from the film **Border**, which was released in 1997 and directed by J.P. Dutta.
 
• 'Sandese Aate Hai' is one of the most beloved patriotic songs in India, evoking strong emotions about the sacrifices of soldiers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Javed Akhtar** has received several awards for his work, including the prestigious **Padma Bhushan** and **Padma Shri**.
 
• He is also known for his work in films such as **Sholay, Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara, and Dil Chahta Hai**.
 
• In addition to his film work, Javed Akhtar is an acclaimed poet and has published several books of poetry.
 
• Javed Akhtar comes from a family with a rich literary heritage, being the son of renowned poet **Jan Nisar Akhtar** and the father of well-known filmmakers **Zoya Akhtar** and **Farhan Akhtar**.
